dict.string: FlowSight captures your screen locally so the on-device model can summarize your work activity. Images stay on this Mac and are deleted after analysis unless you enable debug capture.
FlowSight may use Apple Events to identify the frontmost app for privacy-preserving activity summaries.
FlowSight only accesses folders you explicitly choose (for example Downloads when exporting a PDF).
